Initial release of smyx-hydroponic-nutrient-assessment-analysis:

- Enables AI visual assessment of hydroponic nutrient concentration using root and leaf images (no EC meter needed).
- Identifies root color and leaf morphology to detect stress and nutrient issues; provides actionable adjustment advice.
- Automatically analyzes and pushes alerts based on periodic image capture in hydroponic systems.
- History report queries fetch results directly from the cloud API, with strict open-id management and markdown table output.
- Designed for hydroponic beginners and experts; reduces error risk and lowers the barrier to successful plant care.
